food.title: A Japanese Chef Spent 15 Years Perfecting Biryani. Tokyo's Michelin Guide Noticed.
food.excerpt: Chef Takamasa Osawa's 10-seat biryani restaurant in Tokyo earned a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Tokyo 2026, making it only the second biryani-focused establishment globally to receive Michelin recognition.
food.nri_angle: The Michelin recognition of a biryani restaurant in Tokyo highlights both the global spread of Indian cuisine and the absence of Michelin coverage from India's own culinary heartlands.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Flipkart Enters Food Delivery With Low Commissions, Targeting Zomato-Swiggy Duopoly
food.excerpt: Walmart-backed Flipkart plans a Bengaluru pilot with restaurant commissions as low as 10%, far below the 25-35% charged by incumbents, as India's $9 billion food delivery market heats up.
food.nri_angle: Flipkart's low-commission entry could reshape food delivery pricing across India, affecting how diaspora families order food back home and signaling cheaper delivery for everyone.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Lion Brewery Co Returns to India After Six Decades With Premium Beer Launch
food.excerpt: The 1836-founded London brewery that helped pioneer India Pale Ale is entering Delhi's premium beer market with Copperdrop Spirits as its distribution partner.
food.nri_angle: Indians in Singapore and the UK, where Lion Brewery Co already operates, will recognise the brand now arriving on home soil, completing an IPA homecoming with cultural resonance.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Beetroot Cutlet Recipe: How To Make Crispy Tikki at Home
food.excerpt: This vibrant beetroot tikki combines grated beets, mashed potato, and Indian spices into a crispy, protein-rich snack that works as an evening nibble, party starter, or even a burger patty.
food.nri_angle: Beetroot cutlets are a simple way for diaspora cooks to recreate a beloved Indian street snack with ingredients available at any grocery store abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Rajasthan Challenges Gujarat's GI Tag on Cumin and Fennel
food.excerpt: Farmers and scientists in Rajasthan are demanding revocation of Geographical Indication tags awarded to Unjha cumin and fennel, arguing Gujarat's largest spice market is a trading hub, not a production region.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora consumers who prize authentic Indian spices, the dispute raises questions about the true origin of cumin and fennel marketed under the Unjha label in international markets.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Plans Lie-Flat Business Class on A350 Fleet as Premium Long-Haul Push Accelerates
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline is developing a dedicated business-class cabin for its 60-strong A350 order, targeting non-stop routes to London, Paris, and Frankfurt from 2027.
travel.image_caption: IndiGo is planning to introduce lie-flat business class seats on its incoming Airbus A350 fleet as the airline expands into premium long-haul routes.
travel.nri_angle: IndiGo's premium push introduces new competition on India-Europe routes popular with diaspora travellers, potentially reshaping pricing on corridors long dominated by Gulf carriers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Maharashtra Completes ₹1,601 Crore Acquisition of Iconic Air India Building in Mumbai
travel.excerpt: The 23-storey Nariman Point landmark, once the airline's headquarters, will be converted into a consolidated government office complex to house scattered state departments.
travel.nri_angle: The Air India building is an iconic symbol for the Indian diaspora — the national carrier's former headquarters that connected India to the world is now transitioning to a new chapter as a state government complex.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Oman Launches Free 14-Day Tourist Visa for 103 Countries — Here's What Indian Travelers Need to Know
travel.excerpt: The sultanate's amended residence regulations open visa-free entry for over a hundred nationalities, but Indian passport holders must meet specific conditions to qualify for the two-week stay.
travel.nri_angle: For the 7.4 million Indians living in GCC countries, Oman's visa-free entry removes a key barrier for weekend getaways, while Indians with US/UK/Schengen visas gain hassle-free access.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: DOJ Files Record 88 Denaturalization Cases, Two Indian-Origin Citizens Targeted
carousel.excerpt: The Trump administration's largest coordinated citizenship revocation effort targets naturalized citizens from 17 countries, including an Indian-born H-1B fraudster and an investment scheme orchestrator.
carousel.image_caption: The U.S. Department of Justice has filed a record 88 denaturalization cases, including two targeting Indian-origin citizens.
carousel.nri_angle: Two Indian-origin naturalized citizens face citizenship revocation — one for H-1B visa fraud, another for investment fraud — amid an unprecedented DOJ campaign that has rattled immigrant communities.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Russia Turns Ukraine's Gas Stations Into Deadly Targets in Escalating Drone War
carousel.excerpt: Over 200 fuel stations have been hit in two months as Moscow retaliates for Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries that have triggered fuel shortages from Crimea to Siberia.
carousel.image_caption: A Ukrainian gas station damaged by a Russian drone strike
carousel.nri_angle: The tit-for-tat energy infrastructure attacks have contributed to global oil price volatility, directly affecting Indian energy import costs and shipping routes.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Netflix's Ted Sarandos Sits Down with Indian Writers as Streaming Giant Deepens India Bet
carousel.excerpt: The co-CEO's evening with screenwriters in Mumbai follows the launch of Netflix's NextGen India Writers' Program and a $2 billion content investment commitment.
carousel.nri_angle: Netflix's investment in Indian storytelling has a direct pipeline to diaspora audiences, who represent a significant share of the platform's viewership for Indian-language content outside India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Osasuna Goalkeeper Gets Bizarre Red Card After Handling Ball Way Outside the Box
carousel.excerpt: Sergio Herrera's attempt to head the ball outside his penalty area went wrong when his hand made contact, leaving Osasuna down to ten men in a La Liga clash against Levante.
carousel.image_caption: A goalkeeper rushing outside the penalty area
carousel.nri_angle: The incident went viral among Indian football fans, highlighting the growing global popularity of La Liga and the ongoing debate about sweeper-keeper tactics in modern football.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: SpaceX Faces Wall Street for the First Time as Stock Slides Below IPO Price
carousel.excerpt: The world's most valuable aerospace company reports its inaugural quarterly earnings today, with shares down roughly 15% from their June IPO and a massive lock-up expiration looming.
carousel.nri_angle: SpaceX employs many Indian-origin engineers, and Starlink's global expansion has implications for connectivity in India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Moves to Bring Back Merchant Fees on UPI, Ending the Free-Transaction Era
carousel.excerpt: An amendment to India's payments law tabled in Parliament would create a legal basis for charging merchants on UPI transactions, potentially affecting the world's largest real-time payments network.
carousel.nri_angle: UPI has become the primary way diaspora Indians send and receive money during visits home, and any fee changes affect the merchants and small businesses they transact with.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
